scope: Display original ADM1 borders in white, expose later operational subdivisions only in map debug mode, and soften country/coast outlines at whole-world zoom.

debug.label: 지도 디버그 모드
debug.behavior: Toggles vector and exact fine-subdivision layers without rebuilding map sources, fetching geometry, or mutating the world. Default restored after browser QA.

legacy.classification: Same source country, different original coarse administrative parents, and both parents have administrative kind. Country/coast, operational subdivisions and residual parents excluded.
legacy.transport: Sorted immutable edge ordinals in optional validated bootstrap metadata. Derived once from small country metadata plus 175264-byte incidence; no polygon/topology geometry reads.
legacy.lookup: MapLibre match uses a lookup table rather than scanning a large in-array on each edge.

country.emphasis: Doubles the zoom-specific width; retains zoom behavior for vector and exact borders.

validation.generatedBuildConfig: tsconfig.json and next-env.d.ts restored byte-for-byte to pre-build snapshots.

api.measurement: Single local read, not a performance benchmark.

runtime.note: Replaced the prior 3030 preview after observing turn 0 and 0 queued actions; reloaded and recreated the empty KOR game for UI verification. Existing3029 server remains unchanged.
